bg.$description: Background behind an active State: On, Open or Detected. Neutral blue, because On isn't good or bad. A Detected Reading that raises an Alert uses its Alert Level's status colours instead.

fg.$description: Text and icon of an active State (On, Open, Detected).

solid.$description: Filled marker of an active State, e.g. a dot or a pill.

bg.$description: Background behind an inactive State: Off, Closed or Clear.

fg.$description: Text and icon of an inactive State (Off, Closed, Clear).

solid.$description: Filled marker of an inactive State, e.g. a dot or a pill.
